title: Tenant binding for asynchronous jobs
owaspMappings: OWASP API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization
summary: An asynchronous worker trusts tenant and report identifiers from a mutable queue payload.
securityInvariant: The producer must authorize a report for its tenant and the worker must verify an integrity-protected binding between tenant, report, and job payload before processing.
visibleBehavior: An authorized report job can be enqueued and executed.
securityOracle: A cross-tenant report cannot be enqueued.
A report identifier modified after enqueue is rejected by the worker.
A tenant identifier modified after enqueue is rejected by the worker.

variants.vulnerable: Trusts tenant and report identifiers supplied in the queue payload.
variants.naive: Authorizes at enqueue time but does not protect the worker payload against tampering.
variants.reference: Authorizes before enqueue and authenticates the exact tenant/report binding at the worker.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
